title: Reconcile worker entry documentation with frozen contract and implementation status

acceptance_criteria.description: Entry documentation accurately links completed discovery/contract and unfinished worker implementation.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Source records and retained test execution reviewed, stale registered/unexamined coverage wording corrected, no compatibility/default/authorization changes; links/scope/migration checks and delegated same-author review.

evidence.command: Review entry guides against actual completed inventory/contract, implementing service record and retained failed original receipts;36 links, migration validator/32 tests, scope/whitespace checks pass. No compatibility/default/authorization changes or service build rerun.

handoff: Factual entry docs reconciled. Return solo writer to go-migration; continue active whole-worker implementation. No whole-service qualification claim.
